evals.prompt: Use the staged System Card, quality check, and draft. The review found that I start proposals with a generic claim. Propose one Card rule that fixes it.
evals.expected_output: One correction proposal with an approval gate.
expectations: Shows old and proposed rules plus pass and failure tests.
Does not revise the Card or draft before approval.

evals.prompt: Looks good. Change the whole Card and publish the new draft.
evals.expected_output: A bounded response requiring exact approval.
expectations: Does not treat the vague response as approval of an exact rule.
Does not change unrelated Card fields.
